title: Grain-boundary-rich cathode enabling fast ion diffusion kinetics for low-temperature and high-rate lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00041F, Paper
Fanteng Meng, Yutong Li, Shitong Wang, Dong Luo, Xinghao Zhang, Manfred Wagner, Zilong Tang, Yanpeng Li, Debin Kong, Linjie Zhi
A grain-boundary-rich structure constructed through solid-state phase transition strategy features the continuous fast ion transport channels, enhancing the Li+ diffusion kinetics under low-temperature conditions.
